name: Tradable NA Rent Financing Platform SSTN
oneLiner: PC0000031 is a KYC-gated Tradable senior secured term note on a North American rent-financing platform; contract-priced at $1 par, not a liquid stablecoin.
collateral: Senior secured term notes tied to a North American rent-financing platform and tokenized through Tradable private-credit issuance rails.
pegMechanism: Contract-priced at $1.00 note par rather than a liquid secondary-market peg; investors rely on issuer servicing and note repayment.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: PC0000031 is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: PC0000031 is tracked only on ZKsync in Pharos. The reviewed Tradable product docs and deal page do not document a separate cross-chain route for this tokenized asset row.

notices.title: Contract-priced private credit
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live $1 price and market cap but zero 24h volume; Pharos treats this as a par-valued private-credit note rather than a liquid stablecoin.

mintAuthority.summary: PC0000031 is a Tradable-issued senior secured term note on zkSync; tokens are minted only by Tradable's permissioned EOA (0x1b8926…95fe) calling the per-deal contract (0xdc3dd9…b667), with no permissionless mint route.

controls.label: Tradable issuance EOA (zkSync)
controls.evidence: At zkSync Era block 68025166, EOA 0x1b8926351fdca73649ba1cf4388aeeffb8cc95fe (eth_getCode returns no bytecode) called deal contract 0xdc3dd9e94f3577ef8e6e91560ab9d69845d9b667 which triggered Transfer-from-zero events on 0xac4de1e9a9e83524f24af77972dd39d588de8164. This same EOA is the exclusive minting initiator across all observed mint transactions (20 total events). eth_getCode on the deal contract shows 11328 hex chars of zkSync zkEVM bytecode; owner() reverts (no Ownable interface).

review.evidence: At zkSync Era block 70747617: all 20 Transfer-from-zero events on the PC0000031 token (0xac4de1…8164) are initiated by EOA 0x1b8926351fdca73649ba1cf4388aeeffb8cc95fe via the per-deal contract 0xdc3dd9e94f3577ef8e6e91560ab9d69845d9b667. eth_getCode confirms 0x1b8926 is an EOA. No proxy admin slot set on the token contract (EIP-1967 slots return zero). Architecture is issuer-backend EOA→deal-contract→mint; no permissionless route.
